subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：TES ether（triethylsilyl ether）？
A. HCl, THF/H₂O
B. PhSH, K₂CO₃, DMF
C. N₂H₄·H₂O, EtOH, heat
D. N₂H₄·H₂O, AcOH, pyridine
explanation: Between TMS and TBS in stability: mild acid removes it while TBS stays.
